<!doctype html><title>Disposable canvas fixture</title><canvas width="640" height="360"></canvas><script>
function startCanvas(){const canvas=document.querySelector('canvas');const c=canvas.getContext('2d');let frame=0;setInterval(()=>{c.fillStyle=frame++%2?'#2050b0':'#f8c050';c.fillRect(0,0,640,360)},33)}
</script>
